description:
Introducing the Relaxed Body 20" w/ Office Chair Seat, the first ebike of it's kind. The Relaxed Body has a unique forward pedaling design, the places the pedals out in front of the rider's body. This allows riders to be closer to the ground making mounting and dismounting this ebike extremely safe and simple. The low step over height adds to the simplicity of riding this ebike. The greatest element of this ebike is the incredibly comfortable office chair style seat. With the high back and the large padded seat, riders will feel a level of comfort like no other electric bike. The seat can slide back and forth to find the perfect position for your body. A unique riding experience. And when it's time to stop pedaling and twist the throttle and cruise while you sit comfortably and enjoy the breeze. The electric motor can either power you by twisting the throttle or by assisting you when you pedal.

The motor is a 750 watt rear mounted motor that can only be described with one word, POWERFUL! Riders up to 350lbs can be powered up hills and around town with the use of electric motor. The 48v 14ah battery can provide a range of up to 50 miles on a single charge. The range will vary based on the weight of the rider, the terrain and how the electric motor during rides. The battery is tucked inconspicuously inside the frame, creating a clean, streamlined appearance. The battery can be charged either when the battery is in the frame or the battery can easily be popped out and charged anywhere you'd like. The tires are 20" x 3" creating a stable base for this ebike to roll on pavement and hard packed trails. The 20" create a low center of gravity on the Relaxed Body, making it easy to balance and ride. The mini ape hangar handlebars can be tilted and raised and lowered to fit your body. They are easy to adjust making it simple to find the right riding position for your body. A perfect blend of comfort and power the Relaxed Body is the absolute best ebike for long journeys you'll want your body to enjoy.
